test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jabalpur - Jhelum river**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Jabalpur** is a city located in the central part of India, in the state of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The city of Jabalpur is actually situated on the banks of the **Narmada river**, not the Jhelum river.
 
• The **Jhelum river** flows through the Kashmir Valley, in the northern part of India, and is not associated with Jabalpur.
 
• This mismatch makes option 4 incorrect, as the other city-river pairs are correctly matched.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Surat - Tapti river**

 
 
• Surat is a city in the western Indian state of Gujarat.
 
• The Tapti river (also known as Tapi) flows westwards through central India and passes through Surat before emptying into the Arabian Sea.
 
 
 
• **Lucknow - Gomati river**
 
 
• Lucknow is the capital city of the northern Indian state of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The Gomati river, a tributary of the Ganges, flows through Lucknow, providing the city with water resources.
 
 
 
• **Ujjain - Kshipra river**
 
 
• Ujjain is an ancient city in the central Indian state of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The Kshipra river flows through Ujjain and is considered sacred in Hinduism, hosting the Kumbh Mela festival.
 
 
 
• **Jabalpur - Narmada river**
 
 
• Jabalpur, located in Madhya Pradesh, is situated on the banks of the Narmada river.
 
• The Narmada is one of the major rivers in central India and is considered one of the seven holy rivers of India.
